items.item_text: Associate degree in Construction Management, Business Administration, Public Administration, Engineering, Architecture, Facilities Management, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Three (3) to five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in construction or project coordination, facilities administration, capital project administration, or a related field. Zero (0) to two (2) years of experience in project management. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: Knowledge of construction administration and project coordination practices. Assist the Construction Project Manager in the planning, design, procurement, construction, and closeout phases of capital and maintenance projects.
Independently manage small-scale or multi-trade projects, as assigned, under general supervision.
Participate in project meetings and site visits to document progress, monitor activities, and identify issues requiring follow-up or resolution.
Review project schedules, contractor payment applications, change orders, and project status reports to support effective project delivery.
Coordinate and track follow-up actions resulting from project meetings, site observations, and stakeholder communications.
Assist in the resolution of routine project issues and coordinate corrective actions under the guidance of the Construction Project Manager.
Support the development of project budgets, cost estimates, funding requests, and financial reporting.
Monitor project scope, budget, schedule, and quality objectives, and provide regular updates to project managers and stakeholders.
Maintain project documentation and records to ensure compliance with organizational standards and project requirements.
Coordinate project meetings, including preparation of agendas, meeting minutes, action items, and follow-up activities.
Maintain project schedules, milestones, deliverables, status reports, and related documentation to support successful project execution.
Coordinate and facilitate communication among architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, vendors, and campus stakeholders.
Track and maintain project records, including Requests for Information (RFIs), submittals, change orders, punch lists, and project correspondence.
Coordinate project closeout activities, including collection of warranties, operations and maintenance manuals, training materials, and record drawings.
Provide responsive customer service and effective communication to internal and external stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
Provide administrative and project support to the Facilities and Construction Project Management departments.
Maintain project files and records, including correspondence, contracts, consultant agreements, drawings, specifications, permits, reports, and other project documentation.
Coordinate procurement and contract administration activities, including purchase orders, invoices, payment applications, contract amendments, change orders, and related documentation.
Assist with public bidding and procurement processes in accordance with applicable policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
Track and maintain project budgets, commitments, expenditures, financial reports, and other project control documentation.
Monitor and maintain compliance documentation, including insurance certificates, preliminary notices, lien releases, waivers, and project closeout requirements.
Prepare reports, spreadsheets, presentations, and project status updates for management and stakeholders.
Maintain project databases, tracking systems, and records to ensure accurate, current, and accessible project information.
Administer the Facilities and Construction Project Management plan room and project archives, including the organization, storage, digitization, retention, and retrieval of project records.
Assist staff, consultants, and contractors in accessing project documentation and archived records while ensuring compliance with departmental recordkeeping and document retention standards.
Supports departmental initiatives, special projects, and operational needs.
Performs other duties as assigned.
